event_definition: At least one recorded native contact between t07_smartphone and frozen_tabletop_collision_slab during the action window.
action_window: From render.pre_static_frames through the last recorded frame, inclusive.
ground_truth_source: Hash-bound published per-frame native contact telemetry.
incomplete_telemetry: Unknown; never silently label absence of an unrecorded contact as a negative.
contact_recording_contract: The original renderer with scene_overrides.record_contacts=true may omit empty contact lists. Any observed phone/table contact is positive; ramp contact alone is not positive.
groups: Identical released background, gravity, repeat and fixed physical context; never pair arbitrary opposite outcomes across groups.
no_observed_flip: Keep all reference answers. Mark the boundary unavailable within the original sampled range.
refinement_failure: Keep the original released opposite-outcome interval and both sides. Do not replace it with an invented point.
inversion_eligibility: Independent; does not filter these reference answers or parameter branches.
formal_admission: Ground-truth and distance registration do not automatically grant formal NearAcc admission.
